# PKM Studio

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A SwiftUI app that manages a PKM knowledge system.

## Scope note

- Available on macOS, iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS.
- Uses Python and Swift services, scripts, commands, and agents.
- Integrates with Obsidian notes, Neo4j graph database, Claude AI LLM, and diabetes websites.
- Provides functions via the App Intents framework to offer actions for use in Shortcuts (workflows), Siri AI (voice interface & natural language), or Spotlight (search).
- Supports development and management of concepts, glossary, taxonomy, thesaurus, ontology, knowledge graph, schema, metadata, and associated development artifacts.

## Broader
